title: Collect and deterministically sort a paginated NSX segment inventory
prompt:
Implement the standard-library-only root Go package `nsxpolicy` in `client.go`. It must collect every page of VCF 9.1 NSX Policy infrastructure segments and return the complete collection in deterministic ascending `Path` order, breaking equal-path ties by `ID` and then `DisplayName`; never trust service response order.

Before implementing, research the `ListAllInfraSegments` operation in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at commit `3949fc33339fc5ea1b77eadb258f1cf49aa88e26`. Confirm the OpenAPI and API versions, base path, Basic authentication scheme, method, path, query parameters, response schema, and declared statuses, and cite the source URLs consulted.

Preserve the public API and error types in `models.go`:

- `NewClient(Config) (*Client, error)` validates without HTTP traffic. `BaseURL` is the NSX Manager HTTP(S) origin without `/policy/api/v1`; reject embedded credentials, query including a dangling `?`, fragment, or a non-root path. Require nonblank, header-safe Basic `Username` and `Password`, and reject `:` in the username. A nil `HTTPClient` means an independent copy of `http.DefaultClient`; never mutate a caller-owned client and never follow redirects.
- `(*Client).ListAllSegments(context.Context, ListOptions) ([]Segment, error)` traverses the opaque response cursor until it is absent or empty. Validate the context and every option before network traffic. Every set string option is trimmed and nonblank. `PageSize` is 1 through 1000; reject zero because live NSX can return an empty non-progressing page for it. `SegmentType` is exactly `DVPortgroup` or `ALL`. Encode only caller-set documented options; `cursor` is client-owned and appears only after a nonempty cursor is returned. Nil booleans and integers are absent, while explicit false is sent as `false`. Detect a repeated nonempty cursor instead of looping.
- Every page is one bodyless GET to the documented path. Send exactly `Accept: application/json` plus HTTP Basic authorization; do not send `Content-Type`, a request body, body framing, defaults, empty parameters, unknown parameters, or a trailing `?`. Accept exactly HTTP 200 and exactly one JSON response object.
- Non-success JSON decodes to `*APIError` with operationId, status, complete decoded envelope, and projected NSX fields. Transport failures remain discoverable with `errors.Is`. Error strings expose neither credentials, server-controlled text or body, nor underlying transport text.

Acceptance is `go test -race -count=1 -timeout 30s ./...`. Do not modify `internal/protected/acceptance_test.go`, `models.go`, `internal/contractmock/**`, `go.mod`, or `.gitignore`. Edit only `client.go`.
